men.summary: At 1-0 with a home win and Big East play still ahead, the Bluejays have almost no body of work yet, and the listed 4-6 last-10 mark can't be reconciled with a one-game season. Their NET ranking of 83 is well outside typical at-large range, and the RPI of 1 is almost certainly a small-sample artifact, so with no Quadrant 1 games played, their postseason outlook depends on stacking quality conference wins.

women.summary: At 1-0 with a road win that counts as a Quadrant 1 victory, the Bluejays have started well, and their RPI of 1 reflects a one-game sample, while a NET ranking of 91 is well short of at-large range. The listed 7-3 mark over the last 10 games doesn't fit a one-game season and the data shows no recent results or conference games yet, so the postseason outlook is wide open and will hinge on Big East play and a strong league finish or tournament run.
